caseName: Lindner v. Court Sec. Officer Newell
caseNameFull: Peter W. LINDNER v. Court Security Officer NEWELL

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until March 16, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance *1481with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
